defect: none; slow-domain data is captured on the slow edge and sampled after a declared 10:1 fast-clock ratio
rationale: The slow data is held from a negative slow-clock edge, while a toggle crosses two fast-clock stages. The generated-clock constraint guarantees the recommended fast/slow ratio and the fast side captures only after the synchronized event.

mutation.description: Reduced prim_sync_slow_fast to its slow-edge capture, synchronized event marker, and qualified fast-domain capture.

provenance.adaptation: Self-contained width-parameterized slow-to-fast sampler with the source timing assumption made explicit in SDC.
